records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Orchard Media!
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Orchard Media* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project or key milestone, 8 days left; only contact is our own welcome email [email:faaebff0] with no customer reply, no tickets. One invite sent shows mild intent, but silence plus Starter plan and zero product progress suggests low unaided activation.

draft.subject: Getting Orchard Media's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

I saw you've already sent a teammate invite — nice start. The next step that usually makes everything click is creating your first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and set up that first project with you — just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Chidi
